newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says no comment at moment on NCB tie-up.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says no comment at moment on NCB tie-up.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita told reporters on Thursday he could not immediately comment on Nippon Credit Bank Ltd's business alliance with Bankers Trust New York Corp.
"I cannot comment as I have still not heard officially (about NCB's plan)," he said.
Asked what he thought about the possibility of a foreign firm taking a stake in a Japanese bank, he replied that it was up to the firms themselves to make such decisions.
He declined to comment on exchange rates when asked about recent sharp movements in currency markets.
Nippon Credit Bank and Bankers Trust said on Thursday they would sign a business alliance in late April. NCB said it was considering the possibility of a capital tie-up with the U.S. bank.
It did not elaborate on the possible equity tie-up.
